native_ui.executor: independent GLib/GIO system D-Bus; no GTK/provider/plugin code
native_ui.gobject_introspection: 1.86.0 build scanner; GLib owns core GIR/typelibs
native_ui.terminal_customization: lightweight shell/profile prompt, preserve user configuration
native_ui.browser_branding: source-build default branding until any official trademark use is qualified

engine.transport: bounded version1 4-byte length/strict UTF8 JSON; runtime/broker/protocol.py and worker.schema.json

installer.plan_body: bounded schema-versioned JSON string across GlobalStorage; strict persisted manifest validation in B12
installer.final_modules_display_privileges: B12 qualification pending; probe module omissions are not release policy

profiles.revision: SHA256 sorted validated relative-path/hash manifest, excluding secrets/state
profiles.root_policy: independent authenticated revocable owner grant; profile/skill/import cannot grant authority

image_assembly.strategy: verified native own-package archives plus explicit per-image allowlists; reuse accepted H13 payload/recipes, no dirty development-root copy as sole closure
image_assembly.foundation_payload: preserve accepted required H13 tools; preserve QA/credential exclusions and native payload/runtime/ownership audits
forbidden_installed_inputs: automatic provider connections or owner grants
image_assembly.transitive_runtime_closure: resolve exact packages from required consumer features; stage/hash/ownership/dependency/ELF checks before assembly; candidates unavailable until qualified

installation_closure.base: deterministic offline native desktop/setup; no LLM required
installation_closure.accounts: fresh target owner/UID/home and account authentication in dedicated B12 flow; never inherit live/builder identity
installation_closure.boot: preserve accepted kernel/initramfs/media-integrity and BIOS/UEFI route; Phase2 installed boot/persistence still needs B12 proof
installation_closure.package_trust: native Dpkg/APT own archives and authenticated repository metadata; no Ubuntu/Debian repositories or unverified vendor scripts
installation_closure.optional_extras: unselected by default, save non-secret intent at end; review/acquire in installed session
installation_closure.provider_credentials: installed account protected store only, separate from Linux account setup
installation_closure.permissions: independent authenticated/revocable owner policy; no imported grants
installation_closure.recovery: transaction IDs/postconditions, no unknown-write replay; actual cancellation/install/update/recovery proofs remain mandatory

optional_catalog.vscode: optional exact vendor distribution/terms qualification candidate
optional_catalog.unqualified_candidates: unavailable; not all mandatory for G2
optional_catalog.hardware: source/redistribution/device/kernel-ABI evidence per pack; no Ubuntu repos, detection alone is not support

budgets.measurement_stages: S01-A inventory/spike B01; desktop B02; service/entry B06; lookup B07; integrated B13

next_slices: B02 smallest native graphics/login package chain and real session, source-backed consumer dependencies only
B03 pinned worker/local inference/tool integration, no hosted credential prerequisite
B04 authenticated owner policy/privileged executor after B01; B05 waits for B03+B04
B12 native installer real disk/boot/accounts/trust/offline base and later acquisition

plugin_contract.launcher: Bubblewrap selected; separately reviewed UID fallback only if same denial boundary proved
plugin_contract.runtime_acceptance: B10 dummy secret/file/egress denial; unknown code disabled until qualified
plugin_contract.browser: isolated Firefox-source profile; native launch/scoped accessibility read, Stop and untrusted-content handling; no owner browser credentials
